messages:
Rae (Product): Quick lab note — users think the Private setup network step is frozen when multiple checks are pending. They keep staring at rows of 'waiting'.
Jun (Design): Saw that too. Low-effort improvement: surface a slim diagnostic ribbon at top that summarizes status and has a single CTA 'Show diagnostics'. Less scrolling, clearer next step.
Priya (Eng): Backend can emit a concise `diagnostic_summary` every few seconds with total/passed/failed and a primary_kb anchor. That avoids per-probe chatter.
Sam (Frontend): Frontend plan: ribbon is keyboard-focusable, announces via aria-live polite, and toggles the expanded probe list. When collapsed only show compact tokens, expand reveals full copy + KB links.
Rae (Product): Copy tweak for ribbon: 'Network checks — 1 issue. Show diagnostics' and small helper: 'Checks usually finish within 30s'. Keep it friendly.
Jun (Design): Visual polish: ribbon 44px high, subtle shadow, left-aligned status icon + text + right-side 'Show diagnostics' button. No timestamps in ribbon to reduce clutter.
Priya (Eng): We'll add a `primary_kb_id` in the summary so the ribbon CTA links straight to the right KB section. Also emit `fail_groups` for grouping firewall/DNS/egress.
Sam (Frontend): Accessibility note: use aria-expanded on the CTA, and only update the live region when pass_count changes to avoid spam. Also reserve icon space to avoid layout shifts.
A11yBot: Rec: aria-live polite, role=status for the ribbon, announce concise phrases only. Provide keyboard shortcut hint in tooltip.
Jun (Design): UX detail: when ribbon shows issues, tapping 'Show diagnostics' should auto-focus the first failing item. Also show a small 'Copy debug code' button on each failed probe for support.
Priya (Eng): We can generate a short `diag_code` per run like DBG-7321 so support can look it up. Backend will avoid shipping IPs; include an opt-in toggle to include traces.
Sam (Frontend): Will prototype ribbon + expand interaction and include the debug-code flow. Small animation: ribbon slides in from top 180ms.
Rae (Product): Action items: Jun mock, Sam prototype +ARIA notes, Priya add summary + diag_code, A11yBot to review. ETA: next Wednesday demo.
Priya (Eng): Opening branch `diagnostic-ribbon` now. Will include schema docs for the summary payload.
Sam (Frontend): I'll post the Figma link and a short screen-reader walkthrough by Tue EOD.
Rae (Product): Thanks — if this reduces 'wizard hung' tickets it's a big win. :sparkles:
